meta.note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Barkpark Unified Aesthetic. HAND-EDIT THIS FILE ONLY. Every surface token (Studio CSS vars, web @theme, Go semrole/taskboard artifact, paper-surface.css, pdrender) is GENERATED from here by W1.2 emitters — never edit generated output; regenerate it. Language-neutral: colors are HSL channels (H S% L%) so per-surface emitters can convert and the '/ alpha' soft-tint machinery + WCAG gate survive.
meta.colorFormat: HSL channels 'H S% L%' (no hsl() wrapper) so emitters can splice into hsl(<channels> / <alpha>) for soft tints
meta.outOfScope: emitters, drift gate, surface adoption (W1.2 / W2+)

_convention.form: Each role has { light, dark } as HSL channels. softAlpha derives status soft-tint fills: hsl(<role channels> / <softAlpha[theme]>).

strongAlpha._note: warn carries a -strong variant in the cloud source; emitters derive it from this alpha over the warn channels.

accent._role: warm amber, decorative — NOT a status

status._note: The four semantic roles ok/info/warn/danger. 'ok' green is health/live-dot and is DELIBERATELY distinct from lifecycle 'done' teal (see lifecycle section). Emitters expose --ok/--info/--warn/--danger and derive -soft (softAlpha) fills; warn also gets -strong (strongAlpha).

reading.stack: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Charter, Georgia, "Source Serif 4", serif
reading._role: serif prose on the paper surface

chrome._note: UI chrome scale (Inter). Studio / web / TUI status text.

reading._note: Prose scale on the paper surface (serif). headingWeight applies to h1-h3.

elevation._note: Shadow ladder. Values are the LIGHT-theme shadows; dark is retuned per surface by emitters (deeper, lower-alpha). Recorded as CSS box-shadow strings.

lifecycle._note: Task-lifecycle vocabulary. RECONCILED 1:1 with internal/semrole/semrole.go (taskLifecycleRoles) + internal/taskboard (theme.go colors, components.go StatusGlyph, spinner.go asciiGlyph/frames, board.go life* consts). role '' = neutral/uncoloured (never a guess). 'color' here is the taskboard glyph hue (adaptive light/dark) and is INDEPENDENT of the semantic status palette above — notably 'done'/'closed' use TEAL, distinct from status.ok GREEN. Emitters that need the semantic role tone read color.status via 'role'.

_default._note: unknown lifecycle degrades to the neutral dot

in_progress._escalation: board-only: warms info -> warn -> danger as the 5-min claim lease burns

done._color_note: TEAL — deliberately distinct from status.ok green (#10b981/#34d399). Finished work recedes.
